teachers:
SATO Yutaro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
-To gain the basic skills needed in processes from finding problems to solutions.
-To understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively.
-To be able to find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objectives, and events.
-To be able to deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly.
-To gain various basic skills to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
-To be able to have a picture of technology fields and engineers of discipline.
advice:
In this course, to achieve the above educational goals, the students will learn the basic skills required for verification and problem-solving processes.
This course will deal with characteristic things of the corresponding department.
One is that the students will learn the basic data-handling skills upon data science needed for data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing → visualization → reporting.
One is that the students will learn the basic skills of “PBL for science and technology” including the basic elements of processes from problem-finding to solution and verification activities.
For “data-handling skills”, students will learn the following contents.
-Measuring the subjective sensation for the media contents quantitatively.
-How to use the technical equipment and software, and measure physical quantities related to sensory quantities.
-The meaning of statistical data and how to represent the data in a graph.
For “PBL for science and technology”, students will lean the following contents.
-Deciding a theme from the viewpoint of sensory or physical quantities.
-How to design things scientifically.
requiredKnowledge:
Basic knowledge of mathematics such as trig functions, logarithms and exponents,
Basic skills of information literacy such as report writing and data analysis.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, to achieve the above educational goals, the students will learn the basic skills required for verification and problem-solving processes.
This course will deal with characteristic things of the corresponding department.
One is that the students will learn the basic data-handling skills upon data science needed for data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing → visualization → reporting.
One is that the students will learn the basic skills of “PBL for science and technology” including the basic elements of processes from problem-finding to solution and verification activities.
For “data-handling skills”, students will learn the following contents.
-Measuring the subjective sensation for the media contents quantitatively.
-How to use the technical equipment and software, and measure physical quantities related to sensory quantities.
-The meaning of statistical data and how to represent the data in a graph.
For “PBL for science and technology”, students will lean the following contents.
-Deciding a theme from the viewpoint of sensory or physical quantities.
-How to design things scientifically.
